_read me: Describing a file here improves its row on the page. It is never what makes it appear:
any file dropped into shared/, rhinelander/ or germantown/ shows up on its own, titled
from its filename. Run `npm run resources` from the folder above site/ to rebuild the page.
title   what it should be called, if the filename isn't right
note    one line about what it is or what to do with it
file    the path inside this folder, e.g. "shared/brief.pdf"
url     a link instead of a file (use one or the other)
added   a date like "2026-10-01", if the file's own date is wrong
